text: Checklist and clock HUD text (white/grey, no backing panel) is nearly unreadable against the light grey stone chimney when standing at the hearth; '11 November 10:38 am' and the checklist lines blend into the stones. tick ~8850

Split log on the ground by the chopping block: with the crosshair right next to the drawn log (b8.png) E says 'Nothing to pick up there'; the crosshair names 'Split logs' only when pointed at empty grass well below the drawn log (this shot). Pick-up target does not match where the log is drawn.

Taking a log from the full woodpile ('Stacked. E takes a log for the fire.') to lay on the andirons un-ticks the checklist item: 'Split firewood and stack it by the hearth' goes from [x] (4 of 4) back to [ ] (3 of 4). The game tells you to use the woodpile for the fire, then counts it against you.

After the reveal, Ada 'settles by the fire' in the rocking chair, but the patchwork quilt draped on the chair is drawn straight through her: only a purple skirt shows under the quilt, no head or torso visible. Crosshair names the 'Patchwork quilt', not Ada.

From the yard after the settler is home: (a) hovering the cabin wall still says 'Weathered, not dirty: the inside needs scrubbing.' though the restoration is Done; (b) no chimney stack or smoke is visible above the roof from the front, so the lit fire only reads through the open door. Fire glow through the doorway looks lovely.

The mare in her paddock reads poorly up close: very dark silhouette, and the head/neck is a thin bent wedge that looks detached from the body; a shed-roof slab fills the top third of the view here. Still hungry after the ending ('Bring her hay from the bale').
